description: Header file defining the VP9VaapiVideoEncoderDelegate class for VP9 video encoding using VAAPI, including configuration, rate control, and reference frame management.

classes.name: VP9VaapiVideoEncoderDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class for VP9 encoding using VAAPI, managing encoding parameters, rate control, and reference frames.

classes.name: EncodeParams
classes.description: Structure holding encoding parameters such as keyframe interval, bitrate, framerate, and QP range.

methods.name: VP9VaapiVideoEncoderDelegate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the encoder delegate with VAAPI wrapper and error callback.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encoder with configuration settings.

methods.name: GetCodedSize
methods.description: Returns the coded size of the video.

methods.name: GetMaxNumOfRefFrames
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of reference frames.

methods.name: GetSVCLayerResolutions
methods.description: Returns resolutions for scalable video coding layers.

methods.name: set_rate_ctrl_for_testing
methods.description: Sets the rate control object for testing purposes.

methods.name: PrepareEncodeJob
methods.description: Prepares an encode job with current parameters.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for an encode job.

methods.name: BitrateControlUpdate
methods.description: Updates rate control based on encoding metadata.

methods.name: GetDefaultFrameHeader
methods.description: Generates default frame header for keyframes or interframes.

methods.name: SetFrameHeader
methods.description: Sets frame header parameters for a picture.

methods.name: UpdateReferenceFrames
methods.description: Updates reference frame list with a new picture.
